what: SP6 E3 recalibration curve: FA and TPR of alarms whose thresholds come from n healthy target runs (conformal and plug-in), per arm and budget; llama primary, gemini descriptive

alarm.esn_score: running max of the CUSUM stream over steps 0..t

metrics.fa: share of held-out healthy runs with a step t that alarm by t
metrics.tpr: share of held-out headline positives (tau <= t) that alarm by t

thresholds.conformal: theta = the ceil((m+1)(1-alpha))-th smallest calibration score; +inf if that index > m (no alarms, reported as such)

budgets.n0: source threshold; only arms that need no target data (TL-raw, MS-raw, ESN-src)
budgets.rejected: leave-one-out inside the n (n ESN refits per draw; per-arm rules would make the comparison unfair)

cross_fit.draw_from: healthy runs of the OTHER folds with a step t
cross_fit.one_draw: one calibration set per fold; FA and TPR pool the 5 folds' test runs

draws.paired: same n -> same n calibration runs; where m differs, the same n runs split by half_split.seed

hgb.pct_reference: rebuilt per (fold, draw) from the draw's n/2 reference runs only

ESN-src.fitted_on: qwen (E2 ESN_i pool), threshold recalibrated on the target
ESN-src.per_draw: each calibration draw also picks one of the 30 fit draws

ESN-refit.fitted_on: the target's own n/2 healthy runs; calibrated on the other n/2

reporting.caveat: the spread over draws is calibration-set variability; test-set sampling is NOT in it (say so in every table)

expectations.stat: mean over draws of headline FA
median over draws of the paired headline TPR difference a - b
median headline TPR of a vs median headline TPR of b (over draws); paired difference also reported
